// A switch over a union with a declared return type that misses a member (no `never` guard).
type Shape = { kind: "circle"; r: number } | { kind: "square"; side: number } | {
  kind: "triangle";
  base: number;
  height: number;
};

export function area(shape: Shape): number {
  switch (shape.kind) {
    case "circle":
      return Math.PI * shape.r ** 2;
    case "square":
      return shape.side ** 2;
  }
}
